definitions.explanation: A vague feeling that something has happened or will happen, usually something bad such as the death or trouble of someone close.

examples.japanese: {虫|むし}の{知|し}らせだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
{虫|むし}の{知|し}らせで、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけた。
examples.english: On a hunch, I suddenly phoned my mother.

examples.japanese: {虫|むし}の{知|し}らせという⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に{限|かぎ}って→に限って：23957_nikagitte⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}わ→遭う：09500_au⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Call it a premonition, but that day of all days I left home early, and so I escaped the accident.

notes:
From the old belief that ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ living inside the body sense things and warn a person.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {虫|むし}の{知|し}らせ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a premonition
- {虫|むし}の{知|し}らせ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、〜: as if by premonition, ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予感|よかん}→予感：11416_yokan⟧: premonition, hunch; neutral, good or bad
- ⟦{胸騒|むなさわ}ぎ→胸騒ぎ：10594_munasawagi⟧: an uneasy feeling of foreboding
